prior_champion_coverage.finding: H8/H9 continued ridge/tree families but omitted the previously accepted H4 neural/tree champion. Their improvement claims apply to their stated classical controls, not to the prior campaign's best accepted model.
prior_champion_coverage.correction: H11 prospectively adds faithful retraining of the exact H4 recipe and applies SDO additions to that same recipe. No saved model checkpoint exists; do not call this checkpoint resumption.
prior_champion_coverage.h4_recipe: 50% multivariate HGB (7 leaves, minimum leaf30) +50% three-seed residual neural mean, multivariate ridge alpha10 base, seeds19/43/101, fixed optimizer steps35/1/15.

sample_weight_scope.finding: Earlier wording that weights affect only loss was too narrow for HistGradientBoostingRegressor. Explicit Ridge imputation/scaling remain unweighted, but HGB also uses weights in its internal histogram bin construction.
sample_weight_scope.effect: Mean-one normalization controls total weight mass/effective regularization while preserving relative class weights; it is not pure loss isolation.
